scripts.setup:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix mcp-server && npm run build --prefix mcp-server
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend && npm run test:mcp
scripts.lint: bash scripts/sites-env.sh -- eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern .next --ignore-pattern backend/dist --ignore-pattern mcp-server/dist
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --prefix backend && npm run test:integration --prefix mcp-server
